'''2012 European Championship Chris Williams LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Williams]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Username:''' TrueMisterSlk
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
